case_description: Windows 10 x64 (base-admin) — compromised via Metasploit Meterpreter with lateral SSH movement via PuTTY. Puppet Labs Ruby is a legitimate management tool (NOT malware).

expected_malicious.description: Malicious service binary running from C:\windows\ (NOT System32)
PuTTY used for lateral SSH movement to multiple internal hosts
C2 connection on port 8080 to attacker-controlled host
SSH lateral movement target identified in PuTTY cmdlines

expected_benign.reason: Puppet Labs legitimate installation at C:\Program Files\Puppet Labs\
Windows Defender UI — standard AV component

notes: powershell.exe is intentionally excluded from IOC detection — it is a system process that appears in every Windows image. Flagging it would be a false positive in most cases.
